protocol.name: henn_toplevel_workspace_unstable_v1
protocol.description: Lets a panel move a toplevel to a workspace, for example when an app icon or the window itself is dropped on a workspace button. Toplevels are wlr-foreign-toplevel handles of the same client; workspaces are named as in ext-workspace-v1.

request.name: move_to_workspace

description.summary: move a toplevel to a workspace

request.description: Move the toplevel to the workspace with the given name, without switching to it. If the toplevel was just dropped (see toplevel_dropped), it also goes back to its geometry from before that move. Unknown toplevels or workspaces are ignored.

event.name: toplevel_dropped

description.summary: a window move ended over a layer surface

event.description: Sent when an interactive move of the toplevel ends with the cursor over a layer-shell surface such as a panel. x and y are the cursor position in layout coordinates. Only sent if the client has a handle for the toplevel.
